evals.prompt: Add a test case that checkout completes and tag it for the hub.
evals.expected_output: Adds a Gherkin case (Given/When/Then, one path) with stable test_id UUID; human actor steps (customer memorizes / uses the memorized order number); one '${arg}' per Gherkin-facing keyword; Set Suite Variable for cross-step handoff, carried to the next case in the same leaf; after indent only single spaces; FAIL attachment path if screenshots exist; does not repeat parent Test Tags.

evals.prompt: Rename Login works to Login succeeds — keep hub history.
evals.expected_output: Keeps the existing test_id; only changes the title.

evals.prompt: Rewrite checkout as Gherkin. Do not hide the clicks inside Complete Checkout.
evals.expected_output: Actor steps stay in the case; keywords only implement how (including IF/loops); business args inlined as '${arg}' with a word after the variable; no IF/ELSE in the case body; user interactions not buried unless totally technical.

evals.prompt: Write a smoke case that verifies the hub web production image Dockerfile meets container build rules.
evals.expected_output: Case names the business artifact and expected outcome; a manual tester could follow the steps; tool names like hadolint stay out of Gherkin (in keywords/Documentation how); stable test_id; one path.
